### What problem does this PR solve?
<!--

For more info, check https://pingcap.github.io/tidb-dev-guide/contribute-to-tidb/contribute-code.html#referring-to-an-issue.

Issue Number: close #55562 

Problem Summary:

BR would report unexpected `BR:Restore:ErrTablesAlreadyExisted` when incremental restore.

### What changed and how does it work?

disable duplicated table check in incremental restore.

issue_context.title: Br SQL client will report "BR:Restore:ErrTablesAlreadyExisted" in incremental backup
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

ref: https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/pull/55044

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

1. create a db and write some data into it
2. do full backup
3. write more data into it
4. do incremental backup
5. create a downstream cluster
6. do full restore and then increasement restore

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

All restore success.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

The increasement restore failed and reports: `BR:Restore:ErrTablesAlreadyExisted`

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

master

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->

review_comments: please also add cases to add variation including db/table level backup and restore in sql.

Two more tests added.
1. full backup and db level restore
2. db level backup and full restore
